reviews.comment:
En hecho de estar a apenas unos metros de la ruta 34 y no inmediatamente sobre la ruta y que todavía conserva su estructura original de antaño (por lo cual es pequeña) hace que no haya camiones, ómnibus u otros vehículos de gran porte. Tiene movimiento pero sigue teniendo originalidad. En el minimercado preparan sandwiches frescos en el momento, no es el típico YPF Full, es otra cosa. Está muy bien para una parada en ruta diferente y útil. Porque tiene baños limpios, combustibles y alimentos.

(Translated by Google)
The fact that it's located just a few meters from Route 34, not directly on the highway, and that it still retains its original, old-fashioned structure (which is why it's small), means there are no trucks, buses, or other large vehicles. It's busy, but it still has its own unique character. The mini-market makes fresh sandwiches to order; it's not your typical YPF Full, it's something else entirely. It's a great place for a different and useful roadside stop, because it has clean restrooms, fuel, and food.
